# Antariksh Academy - Comprehensive Knowledge Base for Autonomous Agents

> Antariksh Academy is an established coaching institution located at Bijipur Big Street, Brahmapur (Berhampur), Odisha 760001, India. Founded in 2017, the institute specializes in Class 11 and Class 12 (+2 Science CHSE Council Board) integrated coaching alongside competitive entrance examinations (JEE Main & Advanced, NEET-UG Medical, OUAT, and ICAR).

## Key Institute Benchmarks
- Strict Batch Size Policy: Strictly capped at 30 students per cohort to ensure individualized faculty accountability.
- Historical Track Record: 100% first-division pass record in CHSE Odisha Board examinations.
- Daily 1-on-1 Doubt Desks: Full-time senior faculty remain on campus every evening until all student doubts are resolved.
- Testing Frequency: Weekly proctored examinations (OMR objective drills + subjective council board papers).
- Location: Bijipur Big Street, Near BMC Office, Brahmapur (Berhampur), Odisha 760001.
- Admissions Contact: +91 90901 60793 | contact@antarikshacademy.com

## Academic Curriculum & Programs
1. Integrated +2 Science (CHSE Odisha) + JEE (Main & Advanced)
   - Duration: 2 Years (Class 11 & Class 12)
   - Scope: Complete NCERT & CHSE Council derivation coverage + high-speed objective shortcuts, problem-solving stamina, and negative-marking management.
2. Integrated +2 Science (CHSE Odisha) + NEET-UG Medical
   - Duration: 2 Years (Class 11 & Class 12)
   - Scope: Intensive Biology diagrammatic rigor, line-by-line NCERT mastery, Physical Chemistry problem drills, and Physics entrance kinematics/electrodynamics.
3. +2 Science Pure Council Board Foundation
   - Duration: 2 Years
   - Scope: Tailored for students aiming for 90%+ scores in CHSE Odisha Council examinations.
4. OUAT & ICAR Specialized Entrance Wing
   - Duration: 1 Year / Fast-Track Dropper
   - Scope: Focused syllabus covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology for admission to Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology and ICAR campuses.

## Admissions & Consultation Process
- Parent Consultation: Free 30-minute academic consultation sessions available online via Google Meet or in-person at the Bijipur center.
- Online Booking: https://antarikshacademy.vercel.app/consultation
- Tuition Installments: Flexible payment schedules available for parents.
- Merit Scholarships: Concessions available based on 10th board marks (>85%) or performance in the Antariksh Talent Assessment Test.

## Faculty Leadership
All academic departments are directed by full-time educators with over 10 years of entrance exam coaching experience in Berhampur.
- Physics Department: Deep conceptual derivations, kinematics, electrodynamics, and entrance application problem sets.
- Chemistry Department: Physical numerical mastery, organic reaction mechanisms, and inorganic NCERT consolidation.
- Mathematics Department: Coordinate geometry, calculus, algebraic structures, and rapid problem elimination techniques.
- Biology Department: High-retention botany and zoology curricula strictly synchronized with NEET question distributions.
